title: 第390章 背刺姐妹花
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他猛的抬起头，视线直直落在了前方的古殿上。

一个可怖的念头，如野草般在心底疯长。

“该不会…该不会她们两个出事了吧！”

一念至此，秦然脸色发白。

“不可能！绝对不可能！！”

他用力捶了捶脑袋，强迫自己清醒。

当初书写原著时的一幕幕画面，在脑海中模糊重现，他疯狂复盘，回忆着所有可能忽略的细节。

“如果没记错的话，古殿中存放的是九尾天狐的一尊分身雕像，对香香和小灵儿的血脉来说，不可能构成威胁。”

“没错，危险不可能来自九尾天狐雕像。”

“那会来自于哪里……”

心中那股烦躁感越来越强烈，可他却迟迟找不到问题的所在。

他抓着头皮，强烈的不安感折磨得他愈发烦躁。

“一定是时间线发生改变，又出现了无法预料的危机。”

“该死！！”

他突然想到了香香今天的心神不宁，心中顿时更慌了。

他无意识地攥紧了拳，“别出事，千万别出事。”

“云江仙！”小云云按住了秦然双肩，疑惑的盯着他的眼睛，“你到底发生什么了？”

秦然像是看见了救命稻草。

“小云云，你的神识能否探入古殿当中？”

女人摇了摇头，“里面有大帝境留下的禁制，以我如今的灵魂状态，暂时做不到。”

秦然深吸了一口气，努力克制着不让自己失控。

古殿只能狐族血脉进入，强闯不是办法，甚至可能会连带着香香和小灵儿遭殃。

现在能做的只有安心等待！！

秘境，第九层玉台上。

香香在一次次昏厥中惊醒。

她化为人身，痛苦地揉了揉额头，目光带着几分疑惑的回望向第八层玉台的方向。

刚才某一瞬间，她似乎感觉到了第八层玉台上有气息波动。

“灵儿，你还好吗？”香香喊了一句，无人回应。

“灵儿？”她又喊了一声。

“我没事的，香香姐姐。”

少女熟悉的声音传了过来。

香香闻声，稍稍松了口气。

少女继续道：“香香姐姐，你获得帝术传承了吗？”

“没有，我…做不到。”香香望着半空中的弧形印记，心有不甘，但也只能叹气。

小灵儿轻笑道：“没关系的，这里邪门的厉害，不然我们放弃吧，陛下还在外面等着我们呢，别让他等太久。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He raised his head sharply and his eyes fell directly on the ancient palace in front of him.

A terrifying thought grew like a weed in my heart.

"Could it be...could something happen to the two of them?"

Qin Ran's face turned pale at the thought.

"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!!"

He hit his head hard and forced himself to wake up.

Scenes from when he wrote the original novel vaguely reappeared in his mind. He reviewed it frantically, recalling all the details that he might have overlooked.

"If I remember correctly, the ancient palace stores a statue of a clone of the Nine-tailed Sky Fox. It cannot pose a threat to the bloodline of Xiangxiang and Xiao Ling'er."

"Yes, the danger cannot come from the nine-tailed fox statue."

"Where would that come from..."

The irritability in his heart became stronger and stronger, but he could not find the problem for a long time.

He scratched his scalp, a strong sense of uneasiness making him more and more irritable.

"The timeline must have changed and there must have been an unforeseen crisis."

"Damn!!"

He suddenly thought of Xiangxiang's uneasiness today, and he suddenly became even more panicked.

He clenched his fists unconsciously, "Don't get into trouble, don't get into trouble."

"Yun Jiangxian!" Xiao Yunyun held Qin Ran's shoulders and stared into his eyes in confusion, "What happened to you?"

Kieran seemed to have seen a life-saving straw.

"Xiao Yunyun, can your spiritual consciousness penetrate into the ancient palace?"

The woman shook her head, "There are restrictions left by the Great Emperor Realm inside. With my current soul state, I can't do it for the time being."

Kieran took a deep breath and tried hard not to lose control.

Only those of the Fox clan can enter the ancient palace. Forced entry is not an option, and Xiangxiang and Xiao Ling'er may even suffer disaster.

All we can do now is wait patiently!!

Secret realm, the jade platform on the ninth floor.

Xiangxiang woke up from fainting again and again.

She turned into a human body, rubbed her forehead painfully, and looked back towards the direction of the jade platform on the eighth floor with some confusion.

At a certain moment just now, she seemed to feel a breath fluctuation on the jade platform on the eighth floor.

"Ling'er, are you okay?" Xiangxiang called, but no one responded.

"Ling'er?" She shouted again.

"I'm fine, Sister Xiangxiang."

The girl's familiar voice came over.

Xiangxiang heard the sound and breathed a sigh of relief.

The girl continued: "Sister Xiangxiang, have you obtained the inheritance of imperial skills?"

"No, I... can't do it." Xiangxiang looked at the arc-shaped mark in the air, feeling unwilling to do so, but she could only sigh.

Xiao Ling'er chuckled and said: "It doesn't matter, the evil here is very powerful, otherwise we should give up. His Majesty is still waiting for us outside, don't let him wait too long."
